meta.audience: people who want to sit down with one task and nothing else
meta.title: FOCUS SPACE
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css in the app repository, the deep green dark theme), its timer ring code (TimerCard.tsx), its wordmark and its captured room, mixer and log. Deep green #14241A / #0E1A12, sage text #E9EDE3 / #D6DCCD, the chrome of the ring and of SPACE (white to #6E7D6A), the sage heat scale #4B6F4F to #D0DCC5.

source.notes: a small room where only one task and the time remain: a pomodoro timer, a task list, synthesised ambient sound and a weekly log, offline as a PWA

the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json: the arched room ready and running (its ring and clock hidden, drawn by the reel), the ambient mixer in three states, the log's seven days and twelve weeks
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's deep green dark theme: grounds #14241A / #0E1A12 / #1A2E20, text #E9EDE3 / #D6DCCD / #BCC7B6, the ring's chrome (#FFFFFF, #99A296, #F7F9F4, #5F6A5E, #E2E6DD) and SPACE's chrome gradient, the heat scale #4B6F4F / #82A17D / #D0DCC5.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 with -0.06em for the stacked FOCUS / SPACE (SPACE in chrome), 750 with -0.05em for the clock (the app's 25:00), 800 for headlines; mono capitals for its labels (FOCUS / READY, AMBIENT / 배경 소리).
rationale.motion: Slow and steady: a door that opens onto one task, a clock that runs in time-lapse while the chrome ring closes round it, sliders easing up one by one, the log filling in.
rationale.sound: Ambient in F major at 96 BPM (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s): pads, glass and a soft pulse, a quiet room for one task.
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the name and the app's line beside its arched room at 25:00; the session starting and running in time-lapse as the ring closes; the log of days and weeks; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the ambient mixer.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
